CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

CHAPTER VIII PROVISIONS ON INVESTIGATION Article 31

(1) Certain Civil Servant Officials within the Regency Government who are granted special authority as Investigators to conduct investigations of criminal acts as regulated in the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) are certain Civil Servants within the Regency Government who are appointed by authorized officials in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(3) The authority of Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include:

a. receiving reports or complaints from a person regarding the existence of a criminal act;

b. taking first action at that time at the scene and conducting examination;

c. ordering a suspect to stop and examining the suspect's identity card;

d. seizing objects or documents;

e. taking fingerprints and photographing a person;

f. summoning persons to be heard and examined as suspects or witnesses;

g. bringing in experts required in connection with the examination of the case;

h. conducting termination of investigation after receiving instructions from the Investigator that there is insufficient evidence or the incident does not constitute a criminal act and subsequently through the investigator notifying this matter to the Public Prosecutor, the suspect or their family;

i. conducting other actions according to law that can be accounted for.

(4) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall notify the commencement of the investigation and submit the results of their investigation to the Public Prosecutor through the Investigator

Officials of the Police of the Republic of Indonesia, in accordance with the provisions stipulated in the Criminal Procedure Code.

CHAPTER IX CRIMINAL PROVISIONS Article 32

Any person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or fails to report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2003 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

CHAPTER X CLOSING PROVISIONS Article 33

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation. In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by its Placement in the Regional Gazette of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Letter f

What is meant by "other violence" is the threat of violence including: any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and coercion, including: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

Letter c

What is meant by "non-discrimination" is child protection provided to all children without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race, class, gender, ethnicity, culture and language, legal status and physical or mental condition.

Letter d

What is meant by "the best interests of the child" is that all actions concerning children carried out by the government, community, legislative bodies, the best interests of the child must be a primary consideration.

Letter e

What is meant by "the right to life, survival and development of the child" is as stated in the Convention on the Rights of the Child, including the right to education, the right to play, the right to create and be creative, as well as the rights inherent in the life of the child to obtain health standards, education and an adequate standard of living for the physical, mental, spiritual, moral and social development of the child.

CHAPTER V MONITORING AND EVALUATION Article 27

(1) The Regency Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, balance and effectiveness of integrated steps in the implementation of policies, programs, activities, Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by Regional Apparatus and PPT.

(3) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities of Protection of Women and Children.

(4) Monitoring is conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of Regional Apparatus that implement policies, activities of Protection of Women and Children.

(5) Monitoring stages as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. planning

b. policy implementation:

c. program implementation; and

d. Protection of Women and Children activities every year.

Article 28

(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of each Fiscal Year or when necessary according to needs.

(2) The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs and activities for the following year.

(3) The evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 18

Letter a

What is meant by "physical violence" is an act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death.

Letter c

What is meant by "sexual violence" is an act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual intercourse and/or forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.

Huruf e

What is meant by "legal services" is to assist victims in undergoing the judicial process by providing legal consultation that includes information regarding victims' rights and the judicial process; accompanying victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court hearings and helping victims to fully describe the violence they experienced; and coordinating with fellow law enforcers, volunteer companions, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should.

Letter e

What is meant by "exploitation" is an act that exploits economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others; an act with or without the consent of the victim including prostitution, forced labor or service, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits; and/or any form of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or indecency.

Letter b

What is meant by "assistance services" includes accompanying victims during the examination and health recovery process; accompanying victims during the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; monitoring the interests and rights of victims in the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of victims from all parties who have no interest, including reporting by the mass media; providing a sense of security to victims; and providing continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage.

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Letter c

What is meant by "medical rehabilitation services" includes first aid to victims; treatment and recovery of physical injuries aimed at restoring the physical condition of victims carried out by medical personnel and paramedics; and referral to health services.

Letter d

What is meant by "neglect" is an act that results in the failure to meet the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, carried out by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care; the act of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate, carried out by parents, guardians, or other parties responsible for their care; the act of neglecting a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide life, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or an act that results in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting proper work

inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Letter d

What is meant by "non-discrimination" is that handling of victims is provided to all victims without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race, class, gender, ethnicity, culture and language, legal status and physical or mental condition.

Letter b

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Article 12

Every organizer of an education unit is obliged to coordinate with relevant child protection agencies if they find Children dropping out of school due to being victims of acts of violence.

Letter e

What is meant by "exploitation" is an act that exploits economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others; an act with or without the consent of the victim including prostitution, forced labor or service, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits; and/or any form of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or indecency.

Letter c

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

CHAPTER VIII PROVISIONS ON INVESTIGATION Article 31

(1) Certain Civil Servant Officials within the Regency Government who are granted special authority as Investigators to conduct investigations of criminal acts as regulated in the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) are certain Civil Servants within the Regency Government who are appointed by authorized officials in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(3) The authority of Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include:

a. receiving reports or complaints from a person regarding the existence of a criminal act;

b. taking first action at that time at the scene and conducting examination;

c. ordering a suspect to stop and examining the suspect's identity card;

d. seizing objects or documents;

e. taking fingerprints and photographing a person;

f. summoning persons to be heard and examined as suspects or witnesses;

g. bringing in experts required in connection with the examination of the case;

h. conducting termination of investigation after receiving instructions from the Investigator that there is insufficient evidence or the incident does not constitute a criminal act and subsequently through the investigator notifying this matter to the Public Prosecutor, the suspect or their family;

i. conducting other actions according to law that can be accounted for.

(4) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall notify the commencement of the investigation and submit the results of their investigation to the Public Prosecutor through the Investigator

Officials of the Police of the Republic of Indonesia, in accordance with the provisions stipulated in the Criminal Procedure Code.

Any person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or fails to report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2003 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

ELUCIDATION OF REGIONAL REGULATION OF PENUKAL ABAB LEMATANG ILIR REGENCY NUMBER YEAR 2019

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER VIII PROVISIONS ON INVESTIGATION Article 31

(1) Certain Civil Servant Officials within the Regency Government who are granted special authority as Investigators to conduct investigations of criminal acts as regulated in the provisions of laws and regulations.

(2) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) are certain Civil Servants within the Regency Government who are appointed by authorized officials in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

(3) The authority of Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include:

a. receiving reports or complaints from a person regarding the existence of a criminal act;

b. taking first action at that time at the scene and conducting examination;

c. ordering a suspect to stop and examining the suspect's identity card;

d. seizing objects or documents;

e. taking fingerprints and photographing a person;

f. summoning persons to be heard and examined as suspects or witnesses;

g. bringing in experts required in connection with the examination of the case;

h. conducting termination of investigation after receiving instructions from the Investigator that there is insufficient evidence or the incident does not constitute a criminal act and subsequently through the investigator notifying this matter to the Public Prosecutor, the suspect or their family;

i. conducting other actions according to law that can be accounted for.

(4) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall notify the commencement of the investigation and submit the results of their investigation to the Public Prosecutor through the Investigator

Officials of the Police of the Republic of Indonesia, in accordance with the provisions stipulated in the Criminal Procedure Code.

CHAPTER IX CRIMINAL PROVISIONS Article 32

Any person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or fails to report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2003 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

CHAPTER X CLOSING PROVISIONS Article 33

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation. In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by its Placement in the Regional Gazette of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

ELUCIDATION OF REGIONAL REGULATION OF PENUKAL ABAB LEMATANG ILIR REGENCY NUMBER YEAR 2019

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. 2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

CHAPTER VIII PROVISIONS ON INVESTIGATION Article 31

(1) Certain Civil Servant Officials within the Regency Government who are granted special authority as Investigators to conduct investigations of criminal acts as regulated in the provisions of laws and regulations.

a. receiving reports or complaints from a person regarding the existence of a criminal act;

b. taking first action at that time at the scene and conducting examination;

c. ordering a suspect to stop and examining the suspect's identity card;

d. seizing objects or documents;

e. taking fingerprints and photographing a person;

f. summoning persons to be heard and examined as suspects or witnesses;

g. bringing in experts required in connection with the examination of the case;

h. conducting termination of investigation after receiving instructions from the Investigator that there is insufficient evidence or the incident does not constitute a criminal act and subsequently through the investigator notifying this matter to the Public Prosecutor, the suspect or their family;

i. conducting other actions according to law that can be accounted for.

(4) The Investigators as referred to in paragraph (1) shall notify the commencement of the investigation and submit the results of their investigation to the Public Prosecutor through the Investigator

Officials of the Police of the Republic of Indonesia, in accordance with the provisions stipulated in the Criminal Procedure Code.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of trafficking in persons.

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to try and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person who experiences social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for instance low economic level, education, environment located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Letter b

What is meant by "assistance services" includes accompanying victims during the examination and health recovery process; accompanying victims during the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; monitoring the interests and rights of victims in the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of victims from all parties who have no interest, including reporting by the mass media; providing a sense of security to victims; and providing continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage.

inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Letter f

What is meant by "other violence" is the threat of violence including: any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and coercion, including: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CHAPTER IX CRIMINAL PROVISIONS Article 32

Any person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or fails to report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2003 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

What is meant by "assistance services" includes accompanying victims during the examination and health recovery process; accompanying victims during the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; monitoring the interests and rights of victims in the examination process at the police, prosecutor's office and court; maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of victims from all parties who have no interest, including reporting by the mass media; providing a sense of security to victims; and providing continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage.
